findings.claim: THE @0x5220 CLASSIFICATION (Prong 2). The slot wall-type codes are produced by view_step_forward_by_facing (0x37a7) + the slot classifiers (0x3828 sides/front, 0x3c11 corners, 0x3dce overlay). INPUTS + STRUCTURE for a port: (1) view cursor = the party (gx,gy,x,y,z) at frame start [0x4fa4/0x4fa2/0x4fa0/0x4f9e/0x4f9c]. (2) view_step_forward_by_facing (0x37a7) advances the cursor by (dx=[bp+0xe], dy=[bp+0x10]) under a 4-facing ROTATION on facing [0x4f9a]: facing0 -> (+dx,+dy); facing1 -> (a+=dy, b-=dx); facing2 -> (-dx,-dy); facing3 -> (a-=dy, b+=dx); then maze_resolve_xy_to_facing (0x35b7) recomputes cell x/y. (3) the classifier (0x3828 @0x38ba) computes cell = z*64 + y*8 + x (`z<<6 + y<<3 + x`) and reads the 2-bit N-wall field at [0x4faa]+0x60 / W-wall at +0x120 (via getbit/getbits thunk 0xe34b/0xe3c1, MSB-first 2 bits/cell) + the pit/chute flag at +0x43a; it returns 0 (open passage -> emitter early-returns, no span) or 2 (solid stone). The maze block near-ptr is [0x4faa] (per-zone, loaded by 0x42). For the reference frame the level-0 N/W grids are decoded in docs/re/findings/wmaze-blit-geometry.json (maze-wall-bits-reference-frame). BOUNDARY (what is NOT fully pinned): the exact mapping from the 0/2 wall code (+ corner geometry + parity) to the specific seamIdx pushed into span_append. The seamIdx is the corner/quad emitter's per-(depth,side,parity) shape-table output; the 14-way corner jump table @0x4776 + the static column tables encode it, but the relocated transient renderer (in-image span_append @0x8711 logs 0 hits on a rebuild; no transient copy located in 0x60000-0x90000) prevented capturing the live emitter args to confirm the formula. WORKAROUND for a port: read the span list as the build output, or hand-simulate the corner emitter's type dispatch once the (depth,side,parity)->corner-type classification (inside 0x3c11) is mapped.

symbol_map.note: 11-byte span @0x50d0 (count 0x50ce). args (wt,x0,x1,seamIdx,clipLo,clipHi,depthField). x0+=seam_x0[0x13a*wt+2*seamIdx]; x1+=seam_x1[0x13a*wt+seamIdx] (x0 2x, x1 1x); no refine if wt==0xff.

symbol_map.name: wall_emit_corner
symbol_map.note: corner/seam emitter; 14-way [bp+6] corner-type jump table @0x4776. Type-9 @0x4720 = the corridor SOLID-wall span (wt=2, x0=0, x1=0, seamIdx=depth+[bp+0xa]); type-8 @0x46f6 (wt=1); types 0/2 = no-op.

symbol_map.name: wall_emit_quad
symbol_map.note: wall-quad emitter; 15-way [bp+6] shape jump table @0x449e. 0/2->0x44c9 (solid, edge-emit only, NO span); 1/3/4->0x4101 (door, span @0x4136..); 5..14 shapes (8/9 span @0x4368/0x43ab).

symbol_map.name: wall_emit_floorceil
symbol_map.note: center/right floor-ceiling fill quad; parity-gated.

symbol_map.name: view_step_forward_by_facing
symbol_map.note: advance the view cursor by (dx=[bp+0xe], dy=[bp+0x10]) under a 4-facing rotation on [0x4f9a]; then maze_resolve_xy_to_facing (0x35b7).

symbol_map.name: view_draw_corridor_sides
symbol_map.note: front/side slot classifier (param 0/0xffff/1); cell=z*64+y*8+x @0x38ba; returns 0 (open) / 2 (solid).

symbol_map.name: view_draw_corridor_corners
symbol_map.note: corner-slot classifier -> [0x5222]/[0x5224] (corner-type fed to wall_emit_corner).

symbol_map.name: corner_shape_jump_table
symbol_map.note: 14 CS-offset entries (delta 0x4564); indexes wall_emit_corner's [bp+6] corner-type.

symbol_map.name: quad_shape_jump_table
symbol_map.note: 15 CS-offset entries; indexes wall_emit_quad's [bp+6] shape/walltype.

symbol_map.name: wall_convergence_left
symbol_map.note: {0,104,128,144} per depth (left-edge vertical extent). DGROUP data.

symbol_map.name: wall_convergence_right
symbol_map.note: {0,216,192,176} per depth (right-edge).

symbol_map.name: wall_seam_x0_table
symbol_map.note: per-walltype seam x0 screen columns, stride 0x13a, indexed 0x13a*wt + 2*seamIdx.

symbol_map.name: wall_seam_x1_table
symbol_map.note: per-walltype seam x1 columns, stride 0x13a, indexed 0x13a*wt + 1*seamIdx (HALF the x0 stride).

symbol_map.name: slot_walltype_array
symbol_map.note: 5 words: front [0x5220], corner-L [0x5222], corner-R [0x5224], left-side [0x5226], right-side [0x5228]. 0=open, 2=solid.

symbol_map.name: span_list
symbol_map.note: 11-byte spans: x0(w) x1(w) clipLo(w) clipHi(w) walltype(b) seamIdx(b) depthField(b).

symbol_map.name: parity_bit
symbol_map.note: (gx+gy+facing)%2 (frame-level); 0x521c is the per-span parity recomputed in the flush.

symbol_map.name: depth_bound
symbol_map.note: =4 (the build + flush depth loop bound).

symbol_map.name: depth_counter
symbol_map.note: build: counts 0..3 up; flush: counts 0x521e..0 down.
